Hi ramp crew,
The departures lead asked me to write about desk cover for the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways, so here is the quick rundown. Please keep an eye on carrier tags, check that each booking note matches the pet label, and send any mismatch to us before the cart leaves the hold area. For arriving passengers, the welcome team should point them to the right lane and keep animals calm while the handoff is made.

When you see rabbit paperwork, <<FACT F082>> Make sure the certificate is stored with the other travel papers and that the copy stays with the file until the trip is closed out. For larger dogs, <<FACT F069>> If the crate looks too tight or the latch is off, stop the move and call the desk before loading.

Please also watch cat bookings closely, especially if the carrier has extra pads or water dishes inside. <<FACT F061>> If anything on the form looks unclear, bring it to the desk right away so we can sort it out before boarding. Thanks for keeping the flow steady and for helping every pet move through safely.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
